rules.about: Asks for a clear address within minutes, then hands the reply to the team.

reach.line: Cannot send. WhatsApp is not connected. SMS is not connected.

rules.title: Update the address from the reply
rules.about: Reads the customer's reply to the unreadable-address message, writes it to Shopify, and checks that Bosta took it. Anything unclear goes to the team.

rules.title: Address too short to find
rules.about: It reached Bosta, but the address looks too short: asks for more before pickup.

rules.title: High-risk order
rules.about: Asks the customer to confirm, with words that fit why the order is risky.

rules.title: Order confirmation
rules.about: Asks every other new cash-on-delivery order to confirm.

rules.title: Abandoned cart
rules.about: One reminder with the cart's link, between 1 and 24 hours after it was left, unless the customer ordered since.

rules.title: Delivery-day reminder
rules.about: On the day the courier takes the parcel out: asks the customer to be there and have the amount ready. Aimed at refusals.
